vref_definition: DMM6500 INPUT HI (Pt) minus INPUT LO (source)
notes: Vref is measured by DMM6500 with INPUT HI at separate Pt and INPUT LO at OECT source. ERef = Vref = V(Pt) - V(source), following the same-sign setting used for this run. ADCMTIndex refers to the latest common CH1/CH2 hardware sample; the DMM reading follows it over LAN. GateV and DrainV are verified ADCMT voltage source setpoints, not independent voltage ADC readings. Settling rows are retained and marked.
